title: All Decked Out Seagrove | KEY.co
meta_description: 2-Minute Walk to Beach | Private Pool | Elevator
description_expanded: All Decked Out in Seagrove Beach is a coastal masterpiece designed for unforgettable vacations. Boasting 5,000 square feet of deck and porch space, this luxurious retreat offers endless outdoor entertainment. Enjoy the private pool with a spacious spa, whip up a feast in the outdoor kitchen equipped with a sink, dishwasher, and ice maker, or take in panoramic views from the two-story rooftop deck. The top deck, complete with two gas fire pits and Adirondack seating, creates a stunning backdrop for celebrations, from engagements to weddings. Inside, the thoughtfully designed first floor features a recreational area, pool access, and a bunk room sleeping six. The second floor offers an open-concept living, dining, and state-of-the-art kitchen area with seamless access to expansive decks. Upstairs, four elegant bedrooms and a wet bar lead to covered and uncovered observation decks, perfect for stargazing and creating cherished memories.
